bug_semantics: SAML.getSession in internal/pkg/auth/interceptor/saml.go treats a saml-session token as single-use by reading SAMLAssertionSpec.used via safe.StateGet and only later writing Used=true in a separate safe.StateUpdateWithConflicts that does not re-check the flag. Concurrent gRPC requests carrying the same token can both observe Used==false, both pass expiry/validation, and both receive an authenticated context as the token owner's email (CWE-367 TOCTOU enabling CWE-294 replay). An attacker who intercepts a victim-issued ephemeral token can authenticate multiple times in the race window, including ConfirmPublicKey of attacker-controlled keys under the victim identity.
flaw_origin: The non-atomic get-then-mark-used sequence is already present in the first public write of getSession. Public git log -L :getSession, pickaxe on 'session was already used' / 'Value.Used = true', and blame on the pre-fix file all attribute those lines to the BUSL open-source root dfcbaae7d0b7d61d3af526f510db7e233cfb6807 (2024-02-29). CHANGELOG at that root names a private-era c0fa5d46 'feat: add support for SAML authentication' in Omni 0.11.0-alpha.0 (2023-06-08), but that SHA is not in the public object store and 404s on GitHub, so no finer public member can be reconstructed. Later public edits to the function are a namespace refactor (c6aaff0f) and the 2026 atomic consume-once fix; they did not introduce the race.

CVE.org/NVD do not yet host CVE-2026-45720, but the GHSA is not withdrawn and the vendor shipped consume-once patches, so this is not FALSE_POSITIVE. Public history of the vulnerable lines begins at the 2024-02-29 BUSL root dfcbaae7, a 227k-line initial dump with no parent; the changelog's 2023 SAML-intro SHA c0fa5d46 is not reconstructable from the public repo or GitHub, so that root is the smallest surviving public BIC (introducer_parent_absent after direct parent-tree verification; not a later move/refactor). c6aaff0f only dropped the namespace argument and did not add the race. The 2026 fix ced79da6 is the first write of the inner Used check-and-set and is the direct/canonical fix; release-branch cherry-picks close the advisory ranges.
